title: Scalar mate and compact-support projection arrow
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, phi:A to B a ring map, and c a compactification of f:X to Y [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For T=X,Y let L_T be any left adjoint of exact derived scalar restriction. For every K in D(X_proet,A), restrict the inverse scalar-adjunction mate of [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars] to A and transport it through the inverse intrinsic realization equivalence. This arrow is isomorphic in the arrow category to the canonical compact-support projection arrow at the realized K and the constant A-module B in degree zero, using [def-weil-derived-tensor]. No compact-support right adjoint or invertibility of either horizontal map is assumed. Its named canonical component is [lem-sf-finite-support-projection]; only the component definition, not its isomorphism conclusion, is used in this identification. The realization inverse is the published intrinsic realization, expressed using the ring structure underlying the monoidal coefficient category; its equation and conservativity are proved.

source.place: Remark Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings (Tag 0GL6), second coefficient square; the identification calculation uses the counit-defined projection arrow of sites-cohomology.tex, Section Projection formula, and its derived adjunction (Tag 07A6). Apply the same formal calculation to the pro-etale ringed topoi, without the etale projection-isomorphism conclusion.

proof.text: On flat-term K-flat representatives, restricted coefficient extension is tensor with the target ring and its unit is x mapped to 1 tensor x. Scalar adjunction uniqueness transports these tensor identifications to the given scalar adjunctions. The normalized proper restriction square identifies its scalar mate with the proper projection counit transpose. The exact open square is normalized by its open unit, so its scalar mate is the inverse open projection formula. Compose with the canonical inverse-image composition isomorphism, and transport through realization. These invertible boundary identifications form the claimed arrow isomorphism. Localization makes the construction independent of resolutions and valid for all unbounded inputs.

theorem support_scalar_projection_identification
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (LX : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A ⥤ proEtaleDerivedCategory X B)
    (LY : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A ⥤ proEtaleDerivedCategory Y B)
    (aX : LX ⊣ (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars X φ).mapDerivedCategory)
    (aY : LY ⊣ (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y φ).mapDerivedCategory)
    (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A) :
    letI : Algebra (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) := φ.ulift.toAlgebra
    let N := ModuleCat.of (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((projectionRealizationInverse Y A).map
      ((proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y φ).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((((mateEquiv aX aY).symm
          (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (sfCompactSupportRestriction c φ).hom)).natTrans).app K))) ≅
      Arrow.mk (ProEtale.compactSupportProjectionComponent
        (@ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) CommRing.toRing) c
          ((projectionRealizationInverse X A).obj K)
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
              ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology Y)
                (@ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) CommRing.toRing)).obj N))))
